sloka: उत्थाय च यथा कालम् राघवः सह सीतया ।उपस्पृश्य सु शीतेन तोयेन उत्पल गंधिना ॥३-८-२॥
transliteration: utthāya ca yathā kālam rāghavaḥ saha sītayā ।upaspṛśya su śītena toyena utpala gaṁdhinā ॥3-8-2॥

translations.english: In the morning Rama and Sita got up in time and took bath in cool, lilyfragrant water.
